title: Restriction of an internal coefficient mate is the specified projection map
statement:
Let $a:\Lambda\to\Lambda'$ be a map of commutative condensed rings [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and $f:X\to Y$ any scheme morphism with small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Put $R_T=p_T^*\Lambda$, $S_T=p_T^*\Lambda'$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use ordinary unbounded internal-module derived categories, uncompleted tensor and the specified $L_{f,R}\dashv F_{f,R}$, $L_{f,S}\dashv F_{f,S}$ [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull, sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Let $D_T=-\otimes^L_{R_T}S_T$, let $V_T$ be scalar restriction, and take the normalized $e_T:V_TD_T\cong(-\otimes^L_{R_T}S_T)$ and $\lambda:L_{f,S}D_Y\cong D_XL_{f,R}$ of [lem-sfb-internal-scalar-pullback-normalization]. Let $b:V_XL_{f,S}\cong L_{f,R}V_Y$ and $d:V_YF_{f,S}\cong F_{f,R}V_X$ be the canonical adjunction-compatible restriction comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction], transported through the fixed internal/section equivalences [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. Let $c:L_{f,R}S_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}S_X$ be the canonical cartesian coefficient pullback induced by $\alpha_f$ [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms] and $\delta$ the canonical derived pullback-tensor comparison $d$ of [def-sfb-module-object-projection-map]. For $M\in D_R(Y)$ the following equality holds in $D_R(X)$:
$$e_{X,L_{f,R}M}\circ V_X(\lambda_M)\circ b^{-1}_{D_YM}=(1\otimes c)\circ\delta_{M,S_Y}\circ L_{f,R}(e_{Y,M}).$$
Define $\rho_K:D_YF_{f,R}K\to F_{f,S}D_XK$ as the $S$-adjunct of $D_X(\varepsilon^R_K)\circ\lambda_{F_{f,R}K}$ [def-sfb-internal-derived-scalar-comparisons]. Let $\pi_{f,K,S_Y}$ be the specified module-object projection map [def-sfb-module-object-projection-map], followed by $F_{f,R}(1\otimes c)$. Then in $D_R(Y)$
$$F_{f,R}(e_{X,K})\circ d_{D_XK}\circ V_Y(\rho_K)=\pi_{f,K,S_Y}\circ e_{Y,F_{f,R}K}.$$
Under the section equivalence the same equation holds with the ringed-topos operations and adjunction of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], the ringed tensor comparison $\delta$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], and the ringed projection morphism defined as the adjunct of $(\varepsilon^R_K\otimes1)\circ(1\otimes c)\circ\delta$. In particular, for each $K$, $\rho_K$ is invertible if and only if this specified $\pi_{f,K,S_Y}$ is invertible. All maps and equalities are natural in $K$; no flatness, properness, boundedness, or completeness is assumed.

theorem internal_scalar_mate_projection (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom a]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (tX : TensorNormalization a X) (tY : TensorNormalization a Y)
    (lam : D a Y ⋙ L Λ' f ≅ L Λ f ⋙ D a X)
    (hX : TensorNormalized a X tX) (hY : TensorNormalized a Y tY)
    (hlam : PullNormalized a f lam) :
    IsIso (scalarRestrictionPush a f) ∧
    ScalarMatePullEquation a f tX tY lam ∧
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory (Modules Λ X),
      (V a Y).map ((rho a f lam).app K) ≫
          (scalarRestrictionPush a f).app ((D a X).obj K) ≫
          (F Λ f).map (tX.derived.hom.app K) =
        tY.derived.hom.app ((F Λ f).obj K) ≫ scalarProjection a f K) ∧
    ScalarMateSectionEquation a f tX tY lam ∧
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory (Modules Λ X),
      IsIso ((rho a f lam).app K) ↔ IsIso (scalarProjection a f K)) ∧
    (∀ (K K' : DerivedCategory (Modules Λ X)) (q : K ⟶ K'),
      ((CondensedRing.derivedTensor Λ Y).map ((F Λ f).map q)).app (B a Y) ≫
        scalarProjection a f K' =
        scalarProjection a f K ≫
          (F Λ f).map (((CondensedRing.derivedTensor Λ X).map q).app (B a X)))
